name: RepeatTimer
description: RepeatTimer: a timer at 1 MHz with a 1 s auto-reload alarm, its ISR giving a semaphore the loop prints from, with millis() as the ISR saw it; the button on IO0 pressed at 3.5 s ends the timer, so there is no fourth.
